Generator and perf-meter modules implemented as simple Spring Integration message sources/sinks.
All modules packaged as uber-jars for deployment via REST API.
assumptions: Spring XD framework is already available and we are adding new modules to it.
Kafka version 0.8.x or later with simple consumer API is used.
HDFS, HAWQ, and GPDB are available in the test environment for integration testing.
The developer has prior experience with Spring XD, Kafka, Hadoop, and JDBC.
U1 scope includes a JDBC source, an HDFS sink, and a JDBC sink (for HAWQ/GPDB).
U2 spike results will directly guide the implementation of the Kafka source module.
U4 sample app is a separate GitHub repository with complete configuration and documentation.
All testing (unit, integration, system) is performed by the same developer.
No external dependencies or team coordination delays are considered.

activities.activity_name: Spike on Kafka Simple Consumer API
activities.activity_description: Study the Kafka simple consumer API functionality, prototype basic usage, document findings, approach, and next steps for implementing a Kafka source module.
Design and implement the Kafka source module using the simple consumer API, including configuration, partition assignment, offset management, and unit tests.
Design and implement the Kafka sink module using the Kafka producer API, including configuration, serialization, and unit tests.

activities.activity_name: Implement REST API for Custom Module Upload
activities.activity_description: Design and implement a REST endpoint in Spring XD admin to accept and deploy custom modules packaged as uber-jars, including file handling, validation, and deployment logic.
Design and implement the generator source module that produces a specified number of messages of given size, with configurable number of threads.
Design and implement the perf-meter sink module that collects message count, timestamp, and rate, logging every N messages to the container log.
Design and implement a JDBC source module for mass data ingestion from relational databases, supporting incremental reads, batch fetching, and configuration.
Design and implement an HDFS sink module to write ingested data to HDFS files, handling partitioning and file format.
Design and implement a JDBC sink module to write data to relational databases like HAWQ or GPDB using batch inserts.
Create a complete sample project on GitHub demonstrating Spring XD cluster with Kafka as message bus and source, including configuration files, scripts, and README.

activities.activity_name: Integration Test for Generator | Perf-Meter Stream (U7)
activities.activity_description: Set up and run the generator|perf-meter stream using Spring XD singlenode, verify message count and log output, measure performance characteristics.

activities.activity_name: Test Coverage for Kafka Source and Sink (U8)
activities.activity_description: Write comprehensive unit tests and integration tests for the Kafka source and sink modules, and ensure they pass in CI builds.
Create user documentation and API docs for all new modules (Kafka source/sink, REST API, generator, perf-meter, JDBC source, HDFS sink, JDBC sink, sample app).
Perform end-to-end integration testing of all new features together, ensuring no regressions and that all user stories are satisfied.
